question_text: Compare supervised classification and unsupervised clustering when analysing customer support requests.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Both use features to organize records. Classification learns from labelled examples to predict predefined categories, such as billing or technical support. Clustering groups similar requests without predefined outcome labels and may reveal previously unrecognized themes; clusters need interpretation.

marking_points.criterion: Clustering groups similarities without class labels.
